core.name: ROC7 quality
core.rule: 0 at ROC ≤0 or ≥20%; full points at +1 to +10%; linear between.

core.name: VMI persistence
core.rule: Last five sessions’ maximum VMI, scaled from 0.98 to 1.08.

core.name: SMA50 proximity
core.rule: Full at SMA50; decreases to 0 at ±15%.

core.name: Relative volume
core.rule: Current volume / prior 20-day mean, scaled from 0.5 to 1.5.

cont.name: RVOL expanding
cont.rule: RVOL strength; half points when declining versus yesterday.

cont.name: Near 20-day closing high
cont.rule: 0 at 90% of 20-day high close; full at the high.

cont.name: Higher lows
cont.rule: Latest five-session low exceeds previous five-session low.

cont.name: ROC discipline
cont.rule: Same ROC7 quality scale as core.

launch.name: Fresh EMA20 reclaim
launch.rule: Same freshness scale as the ROC cross.

launch.name: ATR launch zone
launch.rule: Full at ATR14/close of 4–8%; linear shoulders to 2% and 12%.

launch.name: SMA50 proximity
launch.rule: Full at SMA50; decreases to 0 at ±15%.

launch.name: Accumulation improving
launch.rule: Half each for VPCI and CMF above five sessions ago.

trade.name: Opening gap
trade.rule: Full at no opening gap; 0 at ±10%.

trade.name: Volatility execution proxy
trade.rule: ATR% scaled inversely from 0 to 15%; this is not a measured bid/ask spread.

strength.name: Price vs SMA20
strength.rule: Distance from SMA scaled from −5 to +10%.

strength.name: Price vs SMA50
strength.rule: Distance from SMA scaled from −5 to +10%.

strength.name: Price vs SMA100
strength.rule: Distance from SMA scaled from −5 to +10%.

strength.name: 63-day high proximity
strength.rule: Closing price / 63-session high close, scaled from 0.7 to 1.

strength.name: Volume imbalance
strength.rule: Signed up/down-session volume / total volume, scaled from −0.4 to +0.4.
